title: Conformalized Lee Inference: Distribution-Free Prediction Sets for Individual Treatment Effect under Monotone Sample Selection
abstract: arXiv:2607.02898v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Treatment can change which outcomes are observed, so treated-selected and selected-control units need not represent the same latent population. This paper proposes conformalized Lee inference for counterfactual prediction under randomized treatment and monotone sample selection. The procedure uses treated-selected observations to fit and calibrate an arbitrary prediction rule and replaces the usual $(1-\alpha)$ score quantile with the adjusted $(1-\alpha\pi)$ quantile, where $\pi$ is the identified share of always-selected units among treated-selected units. The resulting prediction set has finite-sample, distribution-free marginal coverage over the sharp Lee ambiguity set. For a selected-control unit, subtracting the observed untreated outcome yields a marginal prediction set for the realized individual treatment effect. The adjusted population cutoff is minimax optimal over the reduced-information identification region. Simulations

translated_title: 共形化Lee推断：单调样本选择下个体处理效应的无分布预测集
translated_abstract: 处理可能会改变哪些结果被观测到，因此“接受处理且被选中”的单元与“未接受处理且被选中”的单元未必代表同一个潜在人群。本文提出了一种用于随机化处理和单调样本选择下反事实预测的共形化Lee推断方法。该程序利用“接受处理且被选中”的观测数据来拟合和校准任意预测规则，并用调整后的 $(1-\alpha\pi)$ 分位数代替通常的 $(1-\alpha)$ 得分分位数，其中 $\pi$ 是在“接受处理且被选中”单元中被识别出的“始终被选中”单元所占比例。所得预测集在尖锐的Lee模糊集上具有有限样本、无分布的边际覆盖率。对于一个“未接受处理且被选中”的单元，减去观测到的未处理结果，即可得到已实现个体处理效应的边际预测集。调整后的总体临界值在缩减信息的识别区域内是最小最大最优的。模拟实验……（摘要未完整提供）
tldr: 本文提出共形化Lee推断方法，在单调样本选择下通过用调整后的 $(1-\alpha\pi)$ 分位数代替常规分位数，为个体处理效应构建了具有有限样本无分布边际覆盖保证的预测集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes conformalized Lee inference, which constructs distribution-free prediction sets with finite-sample marginal coverage for individual treatment effects under monotone sample selection by replacing the usual (1−α) score quantile with an adjusted (1−απ) quantile.
